required.name: title
required.label: Page title
required.why: Without a title the agent has nothing to call the page and nothing to match a query against.

required.name: description
required.label: Description
required.why: One sentence of your own is what stops the agent describing the page from whatever text it found first.

required.name: primary-action-url
required.label: Primary link
required.why: Tells the agent the one thing this page wants someone to do, which is the only intent it can infer reliably.

recommended.name: updated
recommended.label: Last updated
recommended.why: Lets the agent weigh this page against a dated source that contradicts it.

recommended.name: org-name
recommended.label: Organisation
recommended.why: Names who is speaking, which an unclassified page rarely makes obvious from its content alone.
